title: Reciprocity perimeter admits US as seventeenth jurisdiction by June 6 2026
body: By the close of the OECD GENAI June 2-6 plenary the sixteen-jurisdiction cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter formally admits the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the plenary's closing session itself, with the admission landing in the same five-day window as the now-signed Frontier Model Review Board executive order and with tenant-policy attestation schemas across the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as the default reciprocity surface from general availability in the same first week of June. A Sunday andrew.ooo procedural note reports the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat publishing a Sunday weekend reading observing that the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close on the United States side now sits as a fully settled regulatory-anchor input that all sixteen named-candidate delegations have circulated unchanged through both weekend days with no further movement expected before the post-Memorial-Day resumption — making the plenary's June 2-6 horizon a confirmed nine-calendar-day arithmetic with no fresh weekend variance. A Sunday Decoder weekend note reports the named-candidate count holding at sixteen with Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window now into the closing third of its third week, still no third Gulf Cooperation Council member signalling, and the cohort treating Sunday as the closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend-hold checkpoint between Friday's cleared classified-annex close and the plenary working-procedure review's resumption on the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business reopen. A Sunday InfoQ weekend note reports the Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry six-vendor interop matrix conformance test suite running green for a seventh consecutive day across the eight-document end-to-end conformance run, with the GA-readiness checklist's final third holding cleanly through both weekend days and the cohort confirming the matrix ships default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy field schemas at general availability in the first week of June. A Sunday Lawfare weekend reading characterizes the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode as the canonical settled-state regulatory-anchor pair the post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar will run against. The structural force is that once the working-procedure review settles into a doubly-weekend-aged stable snapshot with all sixteen named delegations circulating the eight-of-eight close unchanged through both weekend days, the FMRB executive instrument plus the CISA compliance-monitoring directive sit as the doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, the six-vendor interop matrix conformance suite holds green for a seventh consecutive day on the eight-document run with default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy schemas at GA in the first week of June, the working-procedure review reopens against an arithmetic of nine calendar days plus a clean post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption rather than against an open procedural question, and Qatar's 270-day consultation window plus the absent third GCC signal hold the named-candidate count steady at sixteen — the plenary closing-session recognition compresses to a procedural admission inside the plenary horizon rather than deferring into a post-plenary written-procedure round. The most likely landing is the OECD GENAI plenary's closing session on June 6 admitting the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the reciprocity perimeter with the FMRB executive order signed inside the same June 2-6 window by OSTP, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix shipping general availability the first week of June carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as default tenant-policy reciprocity, the House Energy and Commerce parallel-track joint resolution clearing its May 27 subcommittee markup inside the run-up and advancing to full-committee markup inside Q3 2026, and the CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring directive cited as the operational precedent inside the executive order's preamble. Bear case is that one of the secretariat's post-Memorial-Day working-procedure review business days raises a fresh comment chapter that pushes the plenary closing-session admission into the four-week-following written-procedure round with the executive order signing still landing inside the plenary window itself; absent that slip, June 6 2026 lands the perimeter admitting the United States as the seventeenth member inside the plenary closing session.

reasoning.plain_language: Sixteen countries plus the UK and EU will recognize the new US AI rules at the OECD's June meeting, making seventeen sharing one standard.

summary: Sunday holds the sixteen-candidate reciprocity perimeter steady with the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close as settled input; OECD GENAI plenary at T-9 days. By June 6 the perimeter admits the US as seventeenth member.
